description_expanded: Welcome to Casa Fiesta, a beautiful home in Crystal Beach, where you can experience the freedom and flexibility to explore at your own pace, making memories that will last a lifetime. With four bikes, a golf cart, a private pool, and half size basketball court included in your stay, you’ll have no problem finding fun things to do. Plus, you’ll be in a prime location, 2 minutes from the closest beach access, near beachside cafes, shopping centers, and fun attractions the whole family will enjoy! Casa Fiesta is a gorgeous two-story home with six bedrooms and six and a half baths accommodating up to sixteen. An entertainer’s dream, this home boasts plenty of room for your whole gang to spread out. The open-concept living/dining area serves as the hub of the home, featuring a living room with a large sofa, several chairs, a flat-screen TV, and access to the private pool outside. Join together at the breakfast bar for morning coffee while the group's chef whips up delicious snacks for the pool and beach in the beautifully appointed kitchen. Play board games at the dining table or just gather to share stories of the day’s adventures. Upstairs is another cozy living space with a large sectional sofa, additional chairs, and a flat-screen TV. Generous, comfortable bedrooms welcome you in after days in the sun, and bathrooms are sunny and luxurious with beautiful details and thoughtful finishes. Plush bedding, flat-screen TVs, and en suite baths ensure each guest blissful sleep in their own private sanctuary, and a washer and dryer are additional conveniences to enjoy during your stay! Enjoy relaxing poolside with your whole crew, soaking up the sun on the chaise lounges and grilling burgers and fresh seafood in the afternoon. Head to Destin’s Harborwalk Village, explore the shops and book an excursion. Whether on a dolphin cruise in the Gulf, paddleboarding on the Bay, or deep sea fishing, you’re bound to find something everyone will enjoy! Shopping enthusiasts can get their fill at Destin Commons and Silver Sands Premium Outlets, and you’ll find plenty of outdoor eateries throughout the area offering fresh seafood cooked to order. Whether you’re a sun seeker, an avid shopper, or an outdoor enthusiast, you’ll find Casa Fiesta in Crystal Beach an excellent start to the perfect getaway! Requests for pool heating must be submitted at least a week prior to arrival and are subject to an additional $75 fee if requested within the week of arrival. Heating for pools is an additional $55 per day. Dog-Friendly Home: Casa Fiesta welcomes your furry family members with open arms! Up to two dogs at 45lbs weight limit can join the vacation fun, creating unforgettable memories together. We maintain the highest standards of comfort and cleanliness, so a non refundable pet fee of $300 applies to help ensure all future guests enjoy a pristine home. Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise.  Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund.
